headline: Shopify, Clickpost and Metabase come online

items.title: Shopify order sync
items.detail: Orders, line items, fulfilments, customers and discounts, with a full historical backfill.

items.title: Clickpost shipment sync
items.detail: Courier tracking data starts landing next to orders.

items.title: Metabase launched
items.detail: Self-hosted dashboards on our own data, with a read-only database user for BI.

items.title: Shared Terraform state
items.detail: Infrastructure state moved to encrypted S3 with a lock, so changes can never collide.

items.title: Shopify backfill survives network errors
items.detail: Retries on network and server errors fixed a crash during the big backfill.
